question: Which offices may run a platform reconciliation, view its runs and exceptions and resolve or write off an exception, what makes a resolution or write-off valid (second approver, evidence, ledger entry), how is a run repeated or corrected, and is reconciliation of the organization platform billing a duty of the union or of the platform operator?
decision: Platform billing reconciliation is a platform operator duty. Platform finance runs it; a resolution or write-off needs a second approver, evidence and a ledger entry. Corrections are new runs, never edits.
originalProposedDecision: Platform billing reconciliation is a platform operator duty. Platform finance runs it; a resolution or write-off needs a second approver, evidence and a ledger entry. Corrections are new runs, never edits.
